Let me analyze this OIML certificate markdown.

Certificate details:
- Certificate number: R60/2000-NL1-08.08
- Scheme: R60 recommendation... scheme field is A|B — the MAA scheme. Actually the OIML-CS has two schemes: A and B. This is a certificate under the MAA — NMi as issuing authority. Typically these older ones... The certificate number format "R60/2000-NL1-08.08" — this is an MAA certificate. Scheme is likely "A" for certificates issued by an issuing authority (national). Hmm, but actually in OIML-CS, Scheme A is for OIML type evaluation and certification issued by Issuing Authorities, Scheme B for Issuing Authorities of Member States... Actually:
  - Scheme A: certificates issued by Issuing Authorities of Member States
  - Scheme B: certificates issued by manufacturers' self-declaration (Utilization Notification)
  
  NMi Certin is an Issuing Authority, so scheme A.

- Project number: 804799
- Page total: 2
- Member state: The Netherlands
- Date issued: 23 July 2008 → 2008-07-23
- oiml_issuer_id: not present explicitly. NMi's issuer ID... not in the document. Omit or null. The schema says fields: number, scheme, project_number, page_total, member_state, date_issued, oiml_issuer_id. If not present, omit per rule 8.

Issuing authority:
- name: NMi Certin B.V.
- address_lines: ["Hugo de Grootplein 1", "3314 EG Dordrecht"] (also P.O. Box 394, 3300 AJ Dordrecht, NL in footer). Use the main address: Hugo de Grootplein 1, 3314 EG Dordrecht, The Netherlands. Actually the address block says "Hugo de Grootplein 1 / 3314 EG Dordrecht / The Netherlands".
- person_responsible: Ing. C. Oosterman
- person_title: Manager Product Certification
- phone: +31 78 6332332
- email: certin@nmi.nl
- website: www.nmi.nl

Applicants: Dini Argeo Srl., Via della Fisica, 20, 41042 Spezzano di Fiorano (MO), Italy

Manufacturers: same.

Certified type:
- category: "Load cell"
- type_designations: ["SBK"]
- module_designation: "Analog load cell"? The certificate says "A shear beam load cell". The R60 module designation... In R60 certs, module is usually "Analog load cell" or "Digital load cell". The doc doesn't say "analog". It says "A shear beam load cell". I'd put module_designation: "Analog load cell"? No — don't fabricate. Rule 8: omit if not present. But schema says module_designation: "Analog load cell" | "Not applicable" | null. Since it's not stated, use null. Hmm. Shear beam load cells are analog, but don't fabricate — set null.

- description: "A shear beam load cell" — free text description.

Fraction: Pi = 0.7 → apportionment factor p_lc = 0.7. Canonical label: apportionment_factor_plc. Value 0.7, no unit.

Model family: Emax range 500 kg to 2500 kg — "500 kg up to and including 2500 kg". This is a range, so the cert covers a family. Is that a model_family? The value is a range {min:500, max:2500} unit kg. I could put it in type_level as maximum_capacity with a range. The rule 4 example shows lists becoming model matrix, but a range is just a range. So maximum_capacity: {value: {min:500, max:2500}, unit_symbol: "kg"}.

Characteristics type_level:
- type: SBK — this is in type_designations.
- apportionment_factor_plc: 0.7
- temperature_range: {min: -10, max: 40}, unit °C
- humidity_class: "CH"
- accuracy_class: "C"
- maximum_number_of_load_cell_intervals_n: 3000 (label: max_load_cell_intervals? Rule 1 example: "Max. number of load cell intervals n_LC" → max_load_cell_intervals_nlc. Here it's "(n)" not n_LC. So "maximum_number_of_load_cell_intervals_n" or "max_load_cell_intervals_n". I'll use "max_load_cell_intervals_n".)
- ratio_y_emax_over_vmin: 10000 (value "10 000" → 10000)
- ratio_z_emax_over_2dr: 3000. Label from example: "Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax/(2*DR)". Rule 1 only gives example for ratio y. I'll use "ratio_z_emax_over_2dr". Value 3000.

Recommendation:
- id: "R60"
- edition: 2000
- amendment: null/omit
- scheme: "A"
- accuracy_classes: ["C"]

Test reports:
- id: "R60/2000-NL1-08.08", pages: 40, role: "type_evaluation_report"
- Also documentation: description with number TC7451 and documentation folder. "the description of the ... with number TC7451 and the appertaining documentation folder" → test_reports entry: {id: "TC7451", role: "documentation_file"}. Date not present.

Revision history: none.

Footnotes: none.

Matrix tables: none.

Model family: single range — I'll skip model_family since it's a range, not multiple distinct models. Actually, the cert covers 500–2500 kg, but no discrete models listed. Rule: "include ONLY if cert covers >1 model variant". The range means multiple variants potentially, but no model identifiers. I'll omit model_family, and put maximum_capacity as a range in type_level.

Date issued: 23 July 2008.

Scheme: The certificate number "R60/2000-NL1-08.08" and issued by NMi as issuing authority → scheme "A".

oiml_issuer_id: not given. Omit.
